consulted_citations.source: 李學勤主編《字源》, 天津古籍出版社／遼寧人民出版社, 2012, ISBN 9787552800692
consulted_citations.field: 日部 entry, printed p. 599 / PDF p. 612; scan pixels directly inspected and matched to supplied source_pixel_sha256. The entry ends on this page; PDF p. 613 (printed p. 600) continues 時, then begins 早.
consulted_citations.text: The 日 entry calls the graph pictographic and says its initial form resembled the sun; it describes later strokes becoming angular, gives sun as the basic meaning, and proposes extensions to sunlight, day, daylight, time, and ruler. These are the author’s explanations; the cited inscription does not establish the order or every semantic transition. In the quoted Shuowen passage, the printed component after 从 looks like 口; the scan alone does not settle its identity against 囗.
